modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: organise work as per organisation’s current health, safety and security policies and procedures
report any breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
identify any risks and hazards associated with work activities, their causes and prevention
ensure workstation and equipment are regularly cleaned and sanitized
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
follow stress and anxiety management techniques

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure that work requirements are accomplished within the specified timeline
ensure team goals are given preference over individual goals
identify ways to optimise usage of material and resources like stationary items, electricity and water in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages around the workstation which may prove to be a potential risk especially around electrical sockets, power sources, computers etc.
check if the electronic appliances and peripherals are properly functioning and are turned off when not in use
identify recyclable and non-recyclable waste generated at the showroom and segregate these into respective categories
deposit recyclable and reusable material at identified location in the showroom’s store/back area

modules.module_title: Host the customer and provide relevant information

pcs.pc_description: greet and meet any showroom walk-in customer with confidence to make him/her comfortable by offering seating and refreshments (tea/coffee/water)
listen and record customer requirements related to purchase of vehicle, model, specifications etc. and hand out brochure and other information
assist the customer to fill personal details in the format provided by dealership/OEM such as name, address, contact number, vehicle exchange, new vehicle details, demographic information etc.
provide basic information related to accessories/VAS or special services and transfer the lead to the relevant department for detailed discussions
promote organisation’s schemes, services, facilities etc.
ensure customer satisfaction by coordinating with colleagues for any queries (sales/services)
introduce the customer to a sales consultant or notify him/her thereby transferring the showroom sales lead
acknowledge customer complaint and apologize for the inconvenience caused and promptly forward the complaint to the concerned department
take feedback from customer and record the same
coordinate with sales team to ensure that all pending work is completed
coordinate with administrative staff to ensure guidelines for showroom maintenance are followed as per OEM checklist
coordinate with sales team/marketing team to promote organization’s new schemes, services, facilities via in-bound calls (newspaper advert etc.)
update oneself regarding any change in schemes/new schemes/events (doctor’s meet/fleet operator meet/new model launch etc.) to be organised by participating in briefings/meetings
complete the scheduled trainings and qualify tests as per OEM standards
